subject: Mediva evaluation: propose owners, success criteria, and demo slots
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medivahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mediva evaluation: propose owners, success criteria, and demo slots

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the clarity on Mediva's three priority areas: real-time patient note generation, embedding-based search across chart notes, and anonymized analytics for care pathways.

Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get your trial started smoothly:

- Proposed kickoff: 60-minute trial kickoff (technical deep dive + success-criteria alignment).
- Suggested owners:
  - Redwood lead: Vanessa Ortiz (me) — trial orchestration, prompts, and demo.
  - Redwood success engineer: Ben Carter — infra, data connectors, and trial runbooks.
  - Mediva lead: Samira Khan — end-to-end evaluation owner.
  - Mediva data/security: please add the appropriate contact (security QA).
- Success criteria (examples; we can refine on kickoff):
  1) Mean latency <= 350ms for 512-token requests (p95 <= 600ms)
  2) F1 >= 0.85 on a 200-sample prompt set for note extraction
  3) Embedding retrieval relevance: MRR >= 0.60 on pilot queries
- Pre-kickoff asks from Mediva:
  - Short list of 10 sample prompts/use-cases
  - Small sample dataset (anonymized) or representative schema
  - Security contact and any attestation questions

Can you share 2-3 60–75 minute windows next week that work for you? We can run the kickoff as a combined demo + technical deep dive so your engineers and product folks get the right context.

I attached a trial charter template and a prompt sample CSV to use as a starting point.

If you'd prefer, I can propose specific slots — let me know timezone preferences.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0184

Attachments:
- trial-charter-template.docx (doc)
- prompt-sample.csv (csv)
